name: matchpoint-ai
description: Smart tennis motion trainer POC using phone sensors, Socket.io, and TypeScript.

scripts.build: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client-mobile/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client-pc/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client-mobile/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client-pc/tsconfig.json && node dist/server/index.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client-mobile/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client-pc/tsconfig.json
